title: Delhi HC gives Centre's grievance committee 15 days to decide on removing Dhruv Rathee's video on Hindu gods eating meat
description: The Delhi High Court on Friday ordered the Central government's Grievance Appellate Committee (GAC) to take a decision within 15 days on removing a YouTube video by Dhruv Rathee in which he allegedly said that Hindu gods Ram, Seeta and Krishna consumed meat and alcohol. A GAC is a government-established body that allows users to appeal decisions made by social media platforms and other online intermediaries regarding complaints about online content or accountsJustice Swarana Kanta Shar
